sentence_stem: Had the committee been informed of the risks in advance,
correct_completion: it would not have approved the proposal.
full_sentence: Had the committee been informed of the risks in advance, it would not have approved the proposal.
acceptable_variants: it would have rejected the proposal outright.
the proposal would never have passed.

options.text: it approves the proposal every year.
options.why_wrong: The stem requires a hypothetical past result. A present habit does not complete the third conditional structure.

options.text: it will have approved the proposal already.
options.why_wrong: A future perfect contradicts the hypothetical past condition, which needs a past conditional result.

options.text: it would not have approved the proposal.
we should inform the committee tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This is a suggestion about future action and does not complete the inverted conditional begun by 'Had'.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional (Had + subject + past participle)
explanation: The inverted form 'Had + subject + past participle' replaces 'if' and expresses an unreal past situation. The main clause must then use 'would have' plus a past participle. Learners may find this inversion unfamiliar because it removes the word 'if'.
translation: Якби комітет був заздалегідь поінформований про ризики, він би не схвалив цю пропозицію.
